name: com.aimstrainingcenter/aims-mcp
title: AIMS Training Center Abu Dhabi MCP Server
description: Model Context Protocol server for AIMS Training Center in Abu Dhabi, UAE. Search 50+ ACTVET-approved courses, inspect syllabi and prerequisites, browse active promotions, read career insights, and retrieve admissions details.

tools.name: search_courses
tools.description: Search AIMS Training Center's 50+ ACTVET-approved courses in Abu Dhabi by keyword, category, or level.

query.description: Keyword to match against course title, category, or description (e.g. AutoCAD, IELTS, Excel, Tally).

category.description: Optional category filter (e.g. Engineering and CAD, Finance & Accounting, IT & Networking, Language Courses).

limit.description: Maximum number of courses to return (default 10, max 50).

tools.name: get_course_details
tools.description: Get full curriculum, overview, duration, level, highlights, and prerequisites for a specific AIMS course by its ID.

courseId.description: The course slug/ID (e.g. tally, engineering-cad, language-courses).

tools.name: get_active_offers
tools.description: List all currently active course discounts, bundles, and promotions at AIMS Training Center Abu Dhabi.

tools.name: list_blogs
tools.description: List published exam-prep and career development articles from the AIMS Training Center blog.

category.description: Optional blog category filter (e.g. IELTS, Exam Prep, Education, Career).

tools.name: get_center_info
tools.description: Retrieve AIMS Training Center Abu Dhabi's official address, phone, email, ACTVET accreditation, hours, and social profiles.
